summary: Iteration 34 — tested CRM backend + Email/Site Note tab split. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed (public /api/leads capture + duplicate + invalid-email 400; admin-guard 401 on /api/admin/crm/*; idempotent sync-users; stats shape; contacts list filters+pagination; full lifecycle create/duplicate/update/notes/get/delete). Frontend: admin dashboard renders new CRM and Email tabs alongside Overview/Users/Site Note. CRM funnel cards, sync users (21 rows), + Add lead modal, search, stage change (qualified), add note, and delete all worked end-to-end. Email tab shows email-setup-wizard (moved out of Site Note). Site Note tab still contains announcement/support/clarity/require-verification cards and saves successfully (toast 'Site settings saved' shown). No regressions detected.

issues: Cards use animate-fade-up with staggered animationDelay (0-150ms); first three cards briefly report is_visible=false to Playwright during initial fade-in. Not user-visible but could cause flaky UI tests. Consider setting initial opacity via CSS state that resolves synchronously or reduce delay.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/crm.py stats: fallback `visitors = heat_events.count_documents({})` when no sessions in last 30d over-counts (returns raw event count instead of unique visitors). Acceptable for cold-start but note.
sync-users updates `type=user` even for pre-existing lead contacts on second run, which correctly promotes converted leads — good; test confirms idempotent 'added' count.

Admin.jsx is now 1973 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Should split into subcomponents/files (CrmTab, EmailTab, SiteNoteTab, UsersTab etc. into separate files) for maintainability. Non-blocking.
Public /api/leads has no rate limiting — spam risk. Consider a simple per-IP throttle before shipping the public lead form.
seed_data_creation: Created transient CRM contacts with unique uuid-emails (leads, dup, crm_ lifecycle) all cleaned up by lifecycle test. Sync-users produced 21 type=user contacts in db.crm_contacts (from real user table).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 34 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration34_crm.py (reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). CRM stages: new/contacted/qualified/proposal/won/lost. Sync-users promotes existing lead-emails to type=user rather than duplicating — idempotency test asserts second call adds 0. Admin.jsx has become large (1973 lines); split-into-modules is recommended before further feature work.
